 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 2 25-07-2023 Heard the parties.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 16(1) (1-a) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

3. The prosecution case is that, the informant who was food inspector took sample of Bunia Laddu and Kalakant for analysis from the shop of M/S Rakesh Sweet Shop, Musrigharari, which has been found adulterated after chemical analysis and this petitioner was the servant of the said shop.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is quite innocent and have committed no offence.
He has been falsely implicated in this case.
The allegation levelled against the petitioner is not specific rather general and omnibus Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.33457 of 2023(2) dt.25-07-2023 in nature.
Petitioner is the servant of the said shop and there is no specific overt act against the petitioner.
He further submits that the owner of the said shop namely, Rakesh Kumar has been acquitted by the Learned Trial Court in Cr. APP No.01 of 2014.

sentences.text: Learned APP for the State opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.

6. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his/her arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court below where the case is pending/Successor Court in connection with G.O. Case No.05 of 2008, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) shikha/-
